hd-editorial-us-independent-shop-v1.shop_type: Independent heavy-duty or fleet shop; not dealer rates.
hd-editorial-us-independent-shop-v1.labor_scope: Labor hours to complete the procedure; hours only, no labor rate.
hd-editorial-us-independent-shop-v1.range_method: Editorial minimum-maximum range per procedure; not a quote; not sourced from OEM documents.

basis_vocabulary.editorial_estimate: Set by the dataset's editors; no price observations, invoices or labor-guide data are recorded for these values.

action_vocabulary.inspect: Visual or physical check without an instrument reading.
action_vocabulary.measure: Instrumented test such as a meter, gauge, pressure, smoke or scope reading.
action_vocabulary.scan: Scan-tool read or command: codes, freeze frame, live data or a bidirectional test.
action_vocabulary.repair: Restore the existing component without a new part: clean, reseat, splice, adjust, flush or refill.
action_vocabulary.replace: Fit a new or remanufactured part.
action_vocabulary.program: Software flash, coding, relearn or calibration.
action_vocabulary.verify: Confirm a completed repair: clear codes, drive cycle, readiness or re-test.

parts_cost_status.estimated: est_parts_cost_min_usd and est_parts_cost_max_usd hold an editorial estimate.
parts_cost_status.none_required: The procedure needs no parts; both values are 0 and it has no replacement_parts rows.
parts_cost_status.unknown: No parts cost estimate exists; both values are NULL.

labor_status.unknown: No labor estimate exists; est_labor_hours is NULL.
